scopeAuthority.rule: Core questions must map to an Advanced knowledge topic/objective. CARs Part IX/other CARs provide legal authority; TC AIM/NAV CANADA/Standards 921/922 provide supporting operational material where applicable.

questions.question: You plan a VLOS RPAS operation 2.5 NM from the centre of a DND-operated aerodrome. What is required?
choices: Authorization from the Department of National Defence
questions.rationale: Current CAR 901.47(4) prohibits RPAS operation within 3 NM of a DND aerodrome unless authorized by DND.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Current CAR 901.47(4) prohibits RPAS operation within 3 NM of a DND aerodrome unless authorized by DND.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the current SFOC-RPAS framework?
choices: Every Advanced operation requires an SFOC
SFOCs are required only for operations captured by CAR 903.01 or when otherwise required by the regulations/Minister
Any RPAS over 25 kg automatically requires an SFOC
Only foreign operators can receive an SFOC
questions.rationale: The current framework uses CAR 903.01 and related provisions; older blanket 25 kg rules are obsolete.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: The current framework uses CAR 903.01 and related provisions; older blanket 25 kg rules are obsolete.

questions.question: What is the minimum age for a flight reviewer rating?
questions.rationale: CAR 901.176(a) requires the applicant to be at least 18 years of age.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.176(a) requires the applicant to be at least 18 years of age.

questions.question: Under the current regulations, which operating weight by itself triggers the SFOC category in CAR 903.01(a)?
questions.rationale: CAR 903.01(a) identifies operation of an RPA having an operating weight of more than 150 kg.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.01(a) identifies operation of an RPA having an operating weight of more than 150 kg.

questions.question: Which qualification is required to perform duties as an Advanced-operation flight reviewer?
choices: Advanced or Level 1 Complex certificate endorsed with a flight reviewer rating, plus required training-provider affiliation
questions.rationale: CAR 901.175 requires both the appropriate endorsed RPAS pilot certificate and affiliation with a declared training provider.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.175 requires both the appropriate endorsed RPAS pilot certificate and affiliation with a declared training provider.

questions.question: In aviation, a ferry flight is best described as:
choices: A flight conducted primarily to reposition an aircraft rather than carry revenue passengers or cargo
A flight conducted only by helicopters
questions.rationale: The term is used in CAR operational exemptions to distinguish non-revenue repositioning activity.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: The term is used in CAR operational exemptions to distinguish non-revenue repositioning activity.

questions.question: A diverted aeroplane at a designated airport may subsequently depart without aircraft firefighting service when the conditions in CAR 602.96 are met. Which is one of those conditions?
choices: The pilot alone decides to leave
The airport operator has advised that firefighting services cannot be made available within the prescribed one-hour period
The aircraft has fewer than 50 passengers
questions.rationale: CAR 602.96(7)(f) sets the notification, one-hour unavailability advice, and operator/PIC agreement conditions.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96(7)(f) sets the notification, one-hour unavailability advice, and operator/PIC agreement conditions.

questions.question: How many RPAs may a pilot operate at the same time unless specifically authorized otherwise by the applicable rules?
questions.rationale: The default principle is one pilot controlling one RPA unless the regulatory framework and authorization permit otherwise.

questions.knowledgeTopic: CAR Part IX - control of RPAS
questions.learningObjective: The default principle is one pilot controlling one RPA unless the regulatory framework and authorization permit otherwise.
questions.source: CAR Part IX - control of RPAS

questions.question: For an SFOC application, which aircraft information may be required for medium/high complexity operations?
choices: Type, manufacturer, model and relevant operating limitations/equipment information

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.02 requires detailed operational and system information appropriate to the complexity of the proposed operation.

questions.question: A training provider associated with flight reviews must ensure reviews are conducted in accordance with:

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Flight-review requirements are tied directly to CAR Part IX and Standard 921.

questions.question: When operating near an aerodrome, what is a core collision-avoidance obligation?
choices: Avoid interfering with aircraft operating in the established traffic pattern
Use ADS-B as the sole means of separation
Land whenever any aircraft is within 10 NM

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.47(1) prohibits operation in a manner that could interfere with aircraft in the established traffic pattern.

questions.question: Which flight is expressly listed as an exception to the designated-airport firefighting-service takeoff/landing prohibition in CAR 602.96(7)?
choices: A revenue charter flight with passengers

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96(7) lists cargo without passengers, ferry, positioning, certain training flights and diversion-related cases.

questions.question: A flight reviewer must be affiliated with:

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.175 links flight reviewer eligibility to declared training-provider affiliation.

questions.question: How long must an applicant have held an Advanced or Level 1 Complex RPAS pilot certificate before applying for a flight reviewer rating?

questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.25 sets 400 ft AGL, with a separate structure-relative provision and authorization pathways.

questions.question: At a designated airport, the firefighting-service takeoff/landing restriction in CAR 602.96(6) applies to certain aeroplanes type-certified to carry at least:

questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96(6) uses the threshold of a type certificate authorizing transport of 20 or more passengers.

questions.question: What conduct is prohibited during an RPAS examination?
choices: Copying or removing examination content contrary to the examination rules

questions.learningObjective: The CAR examination rules prohibit misconduct such as copying/removing exam content or receiving unauthorized assistance.

questions.learningObjective: Examination integrity rules prohibit unauthorized assistance.

questions.question: Which item would generally NOT be an operational-safety element of an SFOC-RPAS application?
questions.rationale: CAR 903.02 focuses on information pertinent to safe conduct of the proposed operation.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.02 focuses on information pertinent to safe conduct of the proposed operation.

questions.question: Which payload may require an SFOC pathway under CAR 901.43?
choices: Weapons, ammunition, hazardous payloads, or a line-suspended payload outside manual provisions

questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.43 restricts listed hazardous or line-attached payloads unless conditions are met, including SFOC authorization where applicable.

questions.question: After failing a flight-reviewer examination, the applicable retest waiting rule is found in:
questions.rationale: Flight reviewer examination retaking requirements are specifically addressed in CAR 901.178.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Flight reviewer examination retaking requirements are specifically addressed in CAR 901.178.

questions.question: Beyond holding the correct endorsed certificate, a flight reviewer must:
choices: Be affiliated with an appropriately declared training provider

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.175 requires training-provider affiliation.

questions.question: Which examination is required for a flight reviewer rating?
choices: Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems - Flight Reviewers

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.176(d) and Standard 921.03 specify the Flight Reviewers examination.

questions.question: A training flight may be exempt from the designated-airport firefighting restriction when:
choices: No fare-paying passengers are on board
The runway is longer than 5,000 ft
questions.rationale: CAR 602.96(7)(d) expressly identifies a training flight with no fare-paying passengers.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96(7)(d) expressly identifies a training flight with no fare-paying passengers.

questions.question: Which statement correctly reflects the current distinction between Advanced and Level 1 Complex operations?
choices: Level 1 Complex is a separate operational division with additional certificate/operator/declaration requirements
Basic permits Level 1 Complex with an observer

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: The 2025 regulatory amendments created a distinct Level 1 Complex framework in Part IX.

questions.question: Unless otherwise directed or published, turns in an aerodrome traffic circuit are normally:
questions.rationale: CAR 602.96 and TC AIM RAC describe the normal left-hand circuit convention unless otherwise directed.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96 and TC AIM RAC describe the normal left-hand circuit convention unless otherwise directed.

questions.question: Which type of urgent operation may justify deviations that would otherwise be restricted, subject to the applicable legal authority?
choices: An operation to save human life

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Part IX contains specific public-authority/life-saving exceptions in several provisions; they are narrow and purpose-specific.

questions.question: Which crew information is relevant to an SFOC-RPAS application?
choices: Names/certificate information or means of ensuring necessary crew qualifications
No crew information is ever required
questions.rationale: CAR 903.02 includes pilot certificate/crew qualification information depending on application complexity.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.02 includes pilot certificate/crew qualification information depending on application complexity.

questions.question: Which weather information belongs in planning for an SFOC operation?
choices: Weather minima and related risk controls appropriate to the operation
Weather is not part of SFOC planning

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: The SFOC application framework requires risk and operational information that addresses safe conduct, including meteorological limitations as applicable.

questions.question: A training provider's obligations concerning flight reviewers are governed primarily by:
questions.rationale: Training-provider and flight-review requirements are contained in CAR Part IX Division X and Standard 921.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Training-provider and flight-review requirements are contained in CAR Part IX Division X and Standard 921.

questions.question: At an uncontrolled aerodrome with an MF area, a radio-equipped aircraft should:
choices: Maintain the required listening watch and make the prescribed reports

questions.knowledgeTopic: TC AIM RAC 4.5.7 / CAR 602.97 et seq.
questions.learningObjective: TC AIM RAC and CAR 602.97-602.103 prescribe MF listening and reporting procedures.

questions.question: Before operating an RPA in controlled airspace under Advanced operations, the pilot must obtain:
choices: Authorization from the air traffic services provider for the area

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.71 requires ATS-provider authorization before controlled-airspace operations under the Division.

questions.question: For an Advanced operation using a declared RPAS, the declaration must address:
choices: The technical requirements applicable to the intended operation under Standard 922

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.194 and Standard 922 establish the safety-assurance declaration regime.

questions.question: Operating manuals for a declared RPAS should define:
choices: Operating limitations and procedures applicable to the system
questions.rationale: CAR 901.31 requires operation in accordance with applicable operating manuals; Standard 922 supports the technical documentation framework.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.31 requires operation in accordance with applicable operating manuals; Standard 922 supports the technical documentation framework.

questions.question: What certification normally distinguishes an 'airport' from a general 'aerodrome' in Canadian regulation?
choices: An airport is an aerodrome for which an airport certificate is in force
Every aerodrome is automatically an airport
The presence of a paved runway alone
questions.rationale: The Aeronautics Act/CAR framework distinguishes certified airports from the broader category of aerodromes.
questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.knowledgeTopic: Aeronautics Act definitions / CAR Part III

questions.question: An SFOC application for a complex operation should address separation and collision-avoidance risk by:
choices: Describing relevant detection/avoidance capability and procedures
Assuming ATC will provide separation in all airspace

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.02 requires risk assessment and, where relevant, DAA/system/procedure information.

questions.question: Which operating-limit information is particularly important in an RPAS operating manual?
choices: Weight, configuration and operating limitations applicable to safe flight

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Operating limitations are core system documentation under CAR 901.31 and Standard 922.

questions.question: If a pilot needs to exceed the normal altitude limits in CAR 901.25, what is required?
choices: Nothing if the RPA is under 1 kg
An applicable authorization pathway, such as an SFOC or controlled-airspace authorization where specifically permitted

questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.25(2) provides an SFOC route, while CAR 901.71(2) addresses higher-altitude operation in controlled airspace when ATS authorization is issued.

questions.question: A manufacturer declaration may cease to support an intended operation if:
choices: The system no longer meets applicable declared technical requirements after a relevant change/modification

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: The declaration/verification framework depends on continued compliance with applicable Standard 922 requirements.

questions.question: Who issues an SFOC-RPAS?

questions.learningObjective: CAR 903.03 provides for issuance by the Minister.

questions.question: Which circumstance can undermine the validity or applicability of a manufacturer's RPAS declaration?

questions.learningObjective: Declared capabilities depend on the model/system meeting the applicable Standard 922 technical requirements.

questions.question: When towing an aircraft on an active movement area at night, the applicable lighting/marking rules come primarily from:
choices: CAR Part III aerodrome operations and applicable airport procedures
questions.rationale: Movement-area vehicle/aircraft operations are governed by aerodrome/airport operating rules and local procedures.

questions.knowledgeTopic: CAR Part III / TC AIM AGA
questions.learningObjective: Movement-area vehicle/aircraft operations are governed by aerodrome/airport operating rules and local procedures.

questions.question: A manufacturer or declarant supporting an RPAS model must make available appropriate:
choices: Maintenance instructions/documentation needed to keep the system airworthy/fit for operation

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: Standard 922 and the declaration/documentation framework require safety-related technical documentation.

questions.question: When a manufacturer identifies a mandatory safety action affecting a declared RPAS, owners/operators should receive:

questions.learningObjective: The declaration/documentation framework requires continued communication of safety-relevant information.

questions.question: A diverted aeroplane's subsequent departure without firefighting service may occur only after:
choices: The prescribed notifications and agreement conditions in CAR 602.96(7)(f) are satisfied

questions.knowledgeArea: Air law, air traffic rules and procedures
questions.learningObjective: CAR 602.96(7)(f) contains specific preconditions.

questions.question: On an aerodrome movement area, aircraft/vehicle activity is subject to:

No restrictions if visibility is good

questions.learningObjective: The normal convention is left turns unless otherwise directed.

questions.question: At minimum, an RPAS operating manual should enable a pilot to understand:

questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.31 makes the applicable operating manuals operationally binding.

questions.question: A safety-assurance declaration under CAR 901.194 is fundamentally a statement that:

The pilot has passed the Advanced exam

questions.learningObjective: CAR 901.194 and Standard 922 establish the declarant's technical-compliance basis.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

Low pressure, high altitude, high humidity

questions.question: As air temperature increases, its capacity to contain water vapour before saturation generally:
questions.rationale: Warmer air has a higher saturation vapour pressure.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Warmer air has a higher saturation vapour pressure.

questions.question: The approximate ISA temperature lapse rate in the troposphere is:
questions.rationale: A commonly used approximation is roughly 2°C per 1,000 ft (6.5°C/km).
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: A commonly used approximation is roughly 2°C per 1,000 ft (6.5°C/km).

questions.question: Lines joining equal atmospheric pressure are:
questions.rationale: Isobars depict pressure patterns and gradients.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Isobars depict pressure patterns and gradients.

questions.question: A relative humidity of 100% means the air is:
choices: Saturated with respect to water vapour at its current temperature
questions.rationale: 100% relative humidity indicates saturation; condensation requires suitable nuclei/processes.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: 100% relative humidity indicates saturation; condensation requires suitable nuclei/processes.

questions.question: An air mass is primarily characterized by its:
questions.rationale: Air masses acquire characteristic temperature and moisture from their source regions.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Air masses acquire characteristic temperature and moisture from their source regions.

questions.question: A practical rule for estimating convective cloud base from surface temperature/dewpoint spread is based on:
choices: The differing lapse rates of temperature and dewpoint
questions.rationale: The temperature-dewpoint spread narrows with height until saturation; this relation is used to estimate cloud base.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: The temperature-dewpoint spread narrows with height until saturation; this relation is used to estimate cloud base.

questions.question: Dewpoint is the temperature to which air must be cooled, at essentially constant pressure and water-vapour content, to:
questions.rationale: Dewpoint is the saturation temperature for the existing vapour content.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Dewpoint is the saturation temperature for the existing vapour content.

questions.question: Cloud droplets grow into precipitation primarily through:
questions.rationale: Precipitation requires droplet/crystal growth beyond simple condensation.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Precipitation requires droplet/crystal growth beyond simple condensation.

questions.question: A temperature inversion exists when temperature:
choices: Increases with height through a layer
questions.rationale: An inversion reverses the normal decrease of temperature with height and is typically stable.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: An inversion reverses the normal decrease of temperature with height and is typically stable.

questions.question: A low-pressure system is commonly associated with:
choices: Rising air, cloud and potentially unsettled weather
Persistent subsidence and guaranteed clear skies
questions.rationale: Low-level convergence and rising motion promote cloud and precipitation.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Low-level convergence and rising motion promote cloud and precipitation.

questions.question: Condensation nuclei are important because they:
choices: Provide surfaces on which water vapour can condense into droplets
questions.rationale: Cloud droplets form efficiently around microscopic aerosols/condensation nuclei.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Cloud droplets form efficiently around microscopic aerosols/condensation nuclei.

questions.question: Which is a recognized North American air-mass category?
questions.rationale: Continental polar is a standard source-region air-mass classification.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Continental polar is a standard source-region air-mass classification.

questions.question: If surface temperature and dewpoint become equal and winds/moisture conditions are favourable, what may form?
questions.rationale: Equality indicates saturation; near the surface this can support fog/stratus formation.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Equality indicates saturation; near the surface this can support fog/stratus formation.

questions.question: The principal North American air-mass classifications used in basic aviation meteorology are based on:
choices: Moisture source (continental/maritime) and thermal source region (e.g., polar/tropical/arctic)
questions.rationale: Air-mass names combine moisture and temperature/source-region characteristics.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Air-mass names combine moisture and temperature/source-region characteristics.

questions.question: A high-pressure system is most often associated with:
choices: Subsiding air and generally more stable/fair conditions
A warm front at its centre
questions.rationale: Highs feature subsidence and divergence, although local exceptions can occur.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Highs feature subsidence and divergence, although local exceptions can occur.

questions.question: Horizontal airflow outward from the centre of a high-pressure system is called:
questions.rationale: Surface highs are associated with divergence.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Surface highs are associated with divergence.

questions.question: A commonly taught cloud-base estimate uses the surface temperature-dewpoint spread because:
choices: Temperature and dewpoint generally change at different rates with height until saturation occurs
questions.rationale: The spread can be converted to an approximate lifting condensation level/cloud base.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: The spread can be converted to an approximate lifting condensation level/cloud base.

questions.question: Which pressure unit is widely used in Canadian aviation weather products?
questions.rationale: Canadian meteorological products commonly use hectopascals; altimeter settings may also be expressed in inches of mercury.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Canadian meteorological products commonly use hectopascals; altimeter settings may also be expressed in inches of mercury.

questions.question: A strong surface-based temperature inversion can contribute to:
choices: Trapping haze, smoke and pollutants near the surface and reducing visibility
questions.rationale: Stable inversion layers suppress vertical mixing and can trap particulates/moisture.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Stable inversion layers suppress vertical mixing and can trap particulates/moisture.

questions.question: An approaching squall line may produce:
choices: Strong gusts, wind shear, heavy precipitation, lightning and severe turbulence
questions.rationale: Squall lines are organized severe convective systems.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Squall lines are organized severe convective systems.

questions.question: Relative humidity is the ratio, usually expressed as a percentage, of:
choices: Actual water-vapour content/pressure to the saturation value at the same temperature
questions.rationale: Relative humidity measures closeness to saturation at the current temperature.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: Relative humidity measures closeness to saturation at the current temperature.

questions.question: Air masses formed over large bodies of water are described as:
questions.rationale: The 'maritime' designation indicates a moist water-source region.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: The 'maritime' designation indicates a moist water-source region.

questions.question: The temperature-dewpoint spread is:
choices: The numerical difference between air temperature and dewpoint
The difference between station and sea-level pressure
The range between gust and steady wind
The difference between true and magnetic north
questions.rationale: A narrowing spread indicates increasing relative humidity and possible approach to saturation.
questions.knowledgeArea: Meteorology
questions.learningObjective: A narrowing spread indicates increasing relative humidity and possible approach to saturation.
